openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The Aruba AP-303 is a 2x2 802.11ac Wave 2 access point. It is fairly powerful with a quad-core ARM processor and 512 MB of memory. The Aruba Instant On AP11 is a much cheaper version of this device and is based on the same platform, the OpenWrt firmware for Aruba AP-303 can also be flashed onto the Aruba Instant On AP11.

openwrt_wiki.serial: To connect to the serial console, you can solder to the labled pads next to the USB port or use your Aruba supplied UART adapter. Do NOT plug a standard USB cable into the Console labled USB-port! ... VCC Unused, D+ TX, D- RX, GND GND. The console setting in bootloader and OS is 9600 8N1. Voltage level is 3.3V. Cheap USB-UART Adapter have failed to work. To enable a full list of commands in the U-Boot "help" command, execute the literal "diag" command.

Do NOT plug a standard USB cable into the Console labled USB-port! Aruba/HPE simply put UART on the micro-USB pins. VCC - NC, D+ - TX, D- - RX, GND - GND. The console setting in bootloader and OS is 9600 8N1. Voltage level is 3.3V.

forum_openwrt_120921.post1_syfy323: Aruba is shipping a new version of their apboot bootloader on new instant on AP 11 devices. Old: APBoot 2.5.0.2 (build 70487) Built: 2019-05-14. New: APBoot 2.6.2.9 (build 81770) Built: 2021-10-05. ... Unknown command 'bootm' - try 'help'
forum_openwrt_120921.post3_blocktrron: The SMB flag is inside Aruba's image header, which itself is signed with their private RSA-key ... Either patch the respective branch instructions or replace the bootloader.
forum_openwrt_120921.post5_syfy323: the bootcode is in the MX25R3235F ... 8-USON
forum_openwrt_120921.post7_blocktrron: the device has it's bootloader on the NOR flash. Partition should be appsbl.
forum_openwrt_120921.post9_syfy323: I've also received new AP-303, they still ship with an old bootloader unlike the AP-11.
forum_openwrt_120921.post10_syfy323: downgrading the bootloader works perfectly and OpenWRT is able to boot. Bad news is, the device settings like serial number and hardware address is also stored there.
forum_openwrt_120921.post12_blocktrron: calibration-data is per-device (!) and should not be interchanged between different boards.
forum_openwrt_120921.post14_syfy323: SPI-Partitionen: sbl1 0x0, mibib 0x40000, qsee 0x60000, cdt 0xc0000, ddrparams 0xd0000, ART 0xe0000, appsbl 0xf0000-0x1e0000, mfginfo, apcd, osss, appsblenv, pds, fcache, u-boot-env-bak, u-boot-env; nur appsbl (skip/seek 983040, count 983040) getauscht

forum_openwrt_177595.post3_robimarko: I have a dump from an older AP11 that worked on OpenWrt: https://public.robimarko.eu/AP11/appsbl.bin
forum_openwrt_177595.post4_luca: tftp appsbl.bin; sf probe 0; sf protect off; sf erase 0x0000000f0000 0xf0000; sf write 0x84000000 0x0000000f0000 0xf0000 ... There is no need do use additional hardware, apboot can write to the SPI flash.

seriell_hinweis.wert: Kein normales USB-Kabel in 'CONSOLE' stecken. Billige USB-UART-Adapter haben nicht funktioniert. In APBoot schaltet 'diag' die volle Befehlsliste frei.
CP2102-Adapter funktionierte; Prolific-Adapter lieferte Zeichensalat. Baofeng-Programmierkabel mit CP2102 geht nach Tausch von rot und grün. Original-Kabel HPE JY728A (AP-CBL-SERU) ist teuer.

bootloader.wert: APBoot 2.6.2.9 (build 81770, 2021-10-05): 'bootm' entfernt, OpenWrt-initramfs startet nicht ('Unknown command 'bootm''); seit etwa Anfang 2022 auf Neugeräten, AP-303 weiter mit altem Bootloader
Neue AP11 seit über einem Jahr mit neuem Bootloader; Geräte mit Stock-Firmware bekommen ihn automatisch per Update
Praktisch alle AP11 haben inzwischen den neueren Bootloader (APBoot 2.6.x)

lauf.notiz: Gluon-Alias von aruba-ap-303, gleiche Plattform (Typenschild-Modell APIN0303, FCC Q9DAPIN0303). ToH-Dump ohne AP11-Zeile: roh.toh ist die AP-303-Zeile; Wiki, Commit und ToH-Datenseite des AP-303 aus dem Cache des Laufs aruba-ap-303 (gleicher Tag). Hersteller-Datenblatt AP11 (2020 und 2021) ausgewertet: innen, 0-40 °C, 802.3af Klasse 3 oder 12 V DC, max. 10.1 W PoE / 8.8 W DC, kein Netzteil beiliegend, 1x GbE, 152x152x34 mm, 193 g. Typenschild und Anschlussfeld aus Fotos in adorfers Forenthread (12V 1A Mitte plus, ENET 57V 350mA, CONSOLE Micro-USB = UART). Kernpunkt: neue AP11 haben APBoot 2.6.2.9 ohne bootm; Bootloader-Tausch über APBoot ohne Öffnen (Darmstadt-Wiki, Werkstatt-Doku, HedgeDoc). DC-Buchsenmass nur vom AP-303 abgeleitet. Blockaden: mojeek.com 403, arubainstanton.com 403, arubainstanton.pl Bot-Challenge, manualslib.com 403 (Cloudflare), hpe.com Timeout, forum.openwrt.org 422 bei ?print=true (ohne Parameter ok).
